summary.value: At the start of a conflict, choose dazed or slow; every hunted creature in the scene immediately suffers it.

system.description: At the start of a conflict, choose dazed or slow; every hunted creature in the scene immediately suffers it. A hunted creature you afflicted must succeed a (WLP + WLP) Opposed Check against you to recover from that status, otherwise it fails. You gain +(SL) to your Checks for this skill.
